column1: # firstmate-config official FirstMate source manifest.
# The single source of the official FirstMate repository, the branch this
# configuration follows, and the commit it was validated against. install.sh
# and bin/fm-update read it through firstmate/fm-stack-manifest.sh, the one
# parsing owner - never duplicate these values as separate hardcoded
# constants in a script or a test.
# Deliberately excluded: auth, credentials, machine paths, the project
# registry, runtime task state, and Captain model routing - those stay owned
# by crew-dispatch.json, captain-startup-models.tsv, and machine-local state.
# firstmate_validated_commit is the full commit hash, not a short one:
# install.sh reasons about it with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`
# (firstmate/fm-stack-manifest.sh:stack_commit_relation), which needs an
# unambiguous object id. A fresh install clones at this commit; fm update
# fast-forwards past it to the branch tip.
# To move the pin: verify the new commit against a real installation, change
# it below, and commit. This file is tracked; nothing here is machine-local
# state.
# Format, tab-separated key<TAB>value:
schema_version
firstmate_repo
firstmate_branch
firstmate_validated_commit
